parameters.name: Neighbor
parameters.description: Neighbor of this ZigBee device. The value MUST be the path name of a row in the ZigBee.ZDO table. If the referenced row is deleted then this entry MUST be deleted.

parameters.name: LQI
parameters.description: The LQI field specified link quality identification (LQI) for neighbor ZigBee device.

parameters.name: Relationship
parameters.description: The relationship between the neighbor and this device.{{enum}}

parameters.name: PermitJoin
parameters.description: An indication of whether the neighbor device is accepting join requests.{{enum}}

parameters.name: Depth
parameters.description: The tree depth of the neighbor device. A value of 0x00 indicates that the device is the ZigBee coordinator for the network.

object.description: The {{object}} object provides the configuration capabilities needed to by a ZigBee Device to operate within a ZigBee Area Network as defined in {{bibref|ZigBee2007|section 2.5.2.4 Network Manager}}.
